codes.bounty_incomplete: Give both the amount and the currency, or neither.
codes.bounty_requires_bbp: A bounty can only be recorded on a bug bounty (BBP) report.
codes.paid_requires_bbp: A paid report must stay a bug bounty (BBP) report.
codes.status_date_in_future: The date cannot be in the future.
codes.status_date_before_previous: The date cannot be earlier than the previous step.
codes.timezone_required: Give the date with a time zone.
codes.tag_invalid: Tags use letters, digits, “-” and “_” (up to 32, no spaces).
codes.range_reversed: The start month is after the end month.

setup.title: Create the owner account
setup.intro: HexOps has no account yet. This will be the only account: there is no sign-up afterwards.
setup.passwordHint: At least 12 characters. A passphrase of several words works well.
setup.recovery: If you forget the password, reset it on this computer with:
setup.localOnly: For safety, the first account can only be created on the computer that runs HexOps. Open HexOps there, or use the command line (python -m app.cli create-user).

search.description: Find reports and notes by words in their title or text.
search.label: Search for
search.hint: All words must match. Words match their forms in English and Russian; Uzbek apostrophes are optional. CVE ids, IPs, domains and URLs match anywhere in the text.
search.startBody: Type a word, an identifier or a host to search every report and note.

pdf.failed: The PDF job failed. Try again.

import.title: Import a PDF
import.description: Turn a text PDF into a Markdown draft, review it, then save it as a new report or note.
import.textOnly: Only PDFs with a text layer. Scanned (image-only) PDFs need OCR, which is not available.
import.manualCorrection: Complex tables, images and page layout may need manual correction.
import.neverOverwrites: Nothing is saved until you choose to create a new report or note. Existing records are never changed.
import.reviewTitle: Pages read: {{pages}}. Review the draft before saving.
import.draftHint: Edit freely. The next step shows the full form before anything is saved.
import.fromDraft: From an imported PDF. Review, then save.

warnings.pdf_tables_detected: Tables were converted to Markdown tables. Check merged or empty cells.
warnings.pdf_images_skipped: Images were skipped. Attach screenshots as evidence if you need them.
warnings.pdf_pages_without_text: Some pages have no text layer (scanned?) and were skipped.

dates.openCalendar: Choose a date from the calendar

errors.date_format: Enter the date as DD/MM/YYYY, day first: 05/06/2026 is 5 June 2026.
errors.date_invalid: This date does not exist (check the day and month).
errors.time_format: Enter the time as HH:mm on a 24-hour clock, e.g. 09:30 or 18:05.

transfer.title: Data export and import
transfer.description: One encrypted .hexops file with all projects, reports, notes, history and evidence files.
transfer.current: This installation: {{projects}} projects, {{reports}} reports, {{notes}} notes, {{files}} evidence files.
transfer.failed: The export or import failed. Nothing was changed.
transfer.passphraseHint: At least {{min}} characters. It is not stored anywhere; without it the file cannot be opened.

export.title: Export all data
export.body: Creates an encrypted archive of every project, report (with status history and bounty), note, tag, history entry and evidence file. Your account and password are not included.
export.keepSafe: Keep the passphrase somewhere safe. HexOps cannot recover it, and anyone who has both the file and the passphrase can read all your data.
export.readyDetail: {{size}}. Download it before {{until}}; after that the file is deleted from the server.

import.title: Import from a .hexops file
import.replaces: An import replaces all records and evidence here with the archive’s; nothing is merged.
import.backupFirst: If this installation has data, a verified encrypted backup of it is made first (in data/backups), and it stays as it is if anything fails.
import.account: Accounts are not in the archive: the records are attached to the account you are signed in with.
import.sameVersion: The archive must come from the same HexOps version (database schema).
import.checked: The archive is intact and complete.
import.compare: Records in the archive and here now
import.populatedBody: Importing replaces all of it. A verified backup is made first and kept in data/backups.
import.understand: I understand that all current records and evidence files will be replaced.
import.confirmBody: Every current record and evidence file is replaced by the archive’s. A verified backup is made first.
import.done: Import finished. All pages now show the imported data.
import.backupKept: The previous data was backed up to {{name}} (encrypted with the same passphrase).

account.hint: Your login name. Records are linked to your account, not to the name.
account.usernameRules: 3–64 characters: letters, digits, “.”, “_” and “-”. Letter case does not matter.
account.signOutNote: After saving you are signed out on every device; sign in with the new username and your current password.
account.usernameChanged: Username changed. Sign in with the new username and your current password.
